factors: payload derivation: mean-pool over the translated span -> LAST translated token
changed_factors_vs_m3_pertoken_receipt.why_two_and_not_one: ADR-024 registers M4h Stage 1 as this combination, because the ladder's open question is precisely whether the three properties CO-OCCURRING matter; each half alone is already covered by a committed receipt (M3 pertoken = on-manifold+pooled+overwrite; M4g = fuse+off-manifold+pooled). Disclosed, not concealed: a null here cannot attribute blame between the two factors.

config.cell: L18->L14 (S2 winner; M4h Stage 1 registers on this cell only)

conditions.aligned_real: sender per-token capture -> M3 MLP per token -> LAST token -> 8-slot delivery, rescaled to natural median, delivered by residual ADD.
conditions.inherited: All four condition definitions are M4g's, unchanged, produced by the same shared code path — see control_semantics_under_fuse_inherited_verbatim_from_m4g above.
conditions.random: per-item seeded gaussian, norm-matched to the effective aligned_real vector, real path. Under fuse a norm-matched, information-free PERTURBATION of the receiver's own rows — exactly the comparator the primary needs.
conditions.zerovec_injected: TRUE ZERO VECTOR through the real 8-slot path (scale: None). Under fuse this is h += 0, an exact NO-OP, so it collapses onto baseline_uninjected. Registered by M4g before M4g's draw, verified there, re-measured here.

injection_operator.equation: h[slot] += c*v (residual add; C2C Eq.3 C_F = C_n(X) + F_n(...))
injection_operator.prior_rungs: overwrite, h[slot] = c*v (all of run 1, and run-2 M3 / M4 / M4c / M4d); fuse first used by M4g

config.natural_norm_source: receiver forward_capture over the slotted injection prompt at the inject block, per item (S0 cross-model precedent)
config.pool_span: NONE — de-pooled. The payload is the last translated token of the generated span; the 8-slot broadcast of that single vector is unchanged.
config.primary_test: ADR-024's M4h registration names one-sided MID-P McNEMAR as this rung's primary, with the frozen exact sign test reported alongside. BOTH are computed on the same collected pairs; neither was selected after seeing the other. gate_pass is computed from the ADR-028-protected EXACT sign test so this rung stays comparable with every prior one.
config.secondary_diagnostic: one-sided sign tests on paired teacher-forced NLL of '#### <gold>'

transform.apply: hand-rolled plain-Rust forward (latentmesh-train cannot be a path dep of runtime examples)
transform.kind: M3's ALREADY-TRAINED reconstruction MLP 2048->512->1536 ReLU — byte-identical weights, no retraining
transform.payload_derivation: apply_last_row: relu(x@W1+b1)@W2+b2 on the LAST generated-span token state only

config.zerovec_gate: pre-committed: pass iff 2 x zerovec accuracy >= baseline accuracy. DEGENERATE UNDER FUSE (zerovec == baseline computation), so it is trivially satisfied and carries NO evidential weight; retained unchanged for cross-rung comparability and labelled here.

aligned_real.definition_unchanged: sender per-token L18 capture -> trained MLP per token -> mean-pool the translated rows -> scale = natural inject-block median / ||pooled|| -> broadcast to 8 slots.
aligned_real.delivery_under_fuse: h[slot] += c*v instead of h[slot] = c*v.
aligned_real.meaning: unchanged in kind — it is still 'the adapter's content, delivered at the registered site with the registered rescale'.

baseline_uninjected.definition_unchanged: no injection at all (spec = None), same slotted prompt.
baseline_uninjected.meaning: unchanged, and PROMOTED in importance: under fuse it is the reference the zero condition collapses onto, so aligned_vs_baseline is the informative 'did adding anything help' contrast.

random.definition_unchanged: per-item seeded ChaCha8 Gaussian (RANDVEC_SEED_BASE + item index), norm-matched to the EFFECTIVE aligned vector, delivered through the same path.
random.meaning: unchanged and still the right comparator: under fuse it is a norm-matched random PERTURBATION of the receiver's own state at those rows, which is exactly the 'same magnitude, no information' control the primary statistic needs. THE PRIMARY STATISTIC aligned_real > random IS THEREFORE UNAFFECTED IN MEANING.

frozen_block.why_this_section_exists: ADR-028 forbids a search or a rung from redefining a control. Changing the injection operator changes what two of the four registered conditions MEAN without changing what they ARE, and that must be recorded before the draw rather than explained after it.

zerovec_injected.consequence_for_the_registered_zerovec_g: the gate '2 x zerovec_correct >= baseline_correct' becomes trivially satisfied under fuse (the two conditions are the same computation). It is still computed and reported, and it is labelled DEGENERATE-UNDER-FUSE in the probe receipt so no reader mistakes it for evidence.
zerovec_injected.definition_unchanged: the true zero vector (vector = 0, scale = None) through the real 8-slot path.
zerovec_injected.deviation_declared: This is a genuine semantic deviation forced by the one changed factor. It is declared here, not concealed. The control is NOT redefined, NOT replaced by a substitute (e.g. an overwrite-with-zero condition retained under a fuse rung), and NOT dropped: it is run exactly as registered, all 40 items, and its now-expected identity to the baseline is MEASURED and reported as an operator-correctness diagnostic (fuse_zero_payload_is_noop, below and in the probe receipt).
zerovec_injected.meaning_CHANGED: under overwrite this ZEROED the eight residual rows — a destructive intervention, and the reason the registered zerovec gate ('2 x zerovec accuracy >= baseline accuracy') was a catastrophe check. Under fuse the identical payload is h += 0, an EXACT no-op, so the zero condition becomes mathematically identical to the uninjected baseline.
zerovec_injected.why_no_substitute_control_was_added: Retaining a destructive overwrite-with-zero condition inside an M4g draw would introduce a second injection operator into a rung whose entire content is that exactly one operator changed, and would be an unregistered addition to a protected control set. The registered four-condition quad already contains the correct 'no information delivered' reference for a fuse rung: baseline_uninjected. It is unchanged and is reported.

control_semantics_under_fuse_inherited_v.reused_not_restated: This rung constructs its controls through the SAME shared common::m3::four_conditions code path M4g ran, under the same InjectionMode::Fuse. M4g's frozen block is echoed below rather than re-authored, so the definitions cannot drift between rungs.

design: docs/adr/024-run2-trained-thought-adapter-ladder.md § 'M4h PRE-REGISTRATION (2026-08-29, before any run) — de-pooling', Stage 1; probe protocol = ADR-023's frozen S1a/S2b protocol inherited unchanged (never iterated, re-drawn, or re-tuned). Evidence basis for de-pooling: docs/research/040-the-pooling-gap.md.

zerovec_not_catastrophic.note: trivially satisfied because zerovec == baseline under fuse; no evidential weight

post_draw_amendment.what_changed: summary.nll_inversion_status was renamed to summary.nll_harm_accounting and its 'question' and 'verdict' prose replaced; a 'corrected_framing' field was added.
post_draw_amendment.what_did_NOT_change: NO measured value, count, statistic, gate, or verdict field elsewhere in this receipt was touched. The three item counts (30 / 30 / 25) and the boolean are byte-identical to what the probe wrote. gate_pass is unchanged (false). The probe was NOT re-run and no second draw was taken.
post_draw_amendment.why: The replaced prose asserted that 'every rung so far has had aligned_real LOSE to both controls on teacher-forced NLL, unanimously across all 40 items'. That statement is FALSE and was inherited from this rung's task brief. While this draw was executing, ADR-024 gained the section 'MAJOR CORRECTION (2026-08-29): the 0/40 NLL inversion is NOT ladder-wide', which establishes from the committed receipts that the unanimous inversion occurs ONLY in the three off-manifold task-loss rungs, and that the on-manifold family (M3, M4 r64/r128/r256 — the family M4h Stage 1 draws its weights from) is inert rather than harmful. Leaving a demonstrably false factual claim standing inside a frozen receipt was judged worse than amending it with this disclosure.
post_draw_amendment.source_also_fixed: examples/run2_m4h_s1_probe.rs carries the corrected framing, so a re-run reproduces this receipt's amended prose rather than the original error.
post_draw_amendment.authority: recorded, not adjudicated — a reviewer who holds that receipts must never be edited after a draw can reconstruct the original two prose strings from this block and from git history.

manifold_precheck_run_before_this_draw.gating: NONE — ORDERING ONLY. Per ADR-024's M4f framing the pre-check is diagnostic; it is required to EXIST and to have measured this exact (artifact hash, derivation) pair before the draw, and it decides nothing about the verdict.
manifold_precheck_run_before_this_draw.scoping_caveat: cosine-to-natural is measured against the POOLED natural receiver state, which ADR-024 notes is itself ~0.667 cosine from a real un-pooled receiver state. The pre-check's own un-pooled reference row (reference-receiver-L14-single-row) is the like-for-like comparator for a de-pooled payload.

no_training_performed.artifact_origin: M3's committed adapter, unchanged; its training receipt was frozen before this rung was conceived
no_training_performed.no_transfer_check_and_why: M4c/M4d/M4g each carried a transfer check because they were TRAINED through a composed path needing reconciliation with the deployed fused BF16 path. Stage 1 trains nothing, so there is no composed-vs-deployed gap to reconcile; M3's own probe likewise had no transfer gate. Asserting one here would be theatre.

slot_count_protected.note: The CONTENT of each slot changes; the NUMBER does not. ADR-024 records that ADR-028 lists 'slot count' on BOTH sides of its evolvable/protected boundary and that the contradiction is flagged, not adjudicated. M4h stays clear of it by construction, and four_conditions asserts positions.len() == 8 at run time.

fuse_zero_is_noop_vs_baseline.expected: EXACT identity — under fuse the zerovec condition is h += 0

nll_harm_accounting.amended_after_the_draw: see post_draw_amendment at the top level — PROSE ONLY; every count in this block is exactly as measured
nll_harm_accounting.corrected_framing: ADR-024 § 'MAJOR CORRECTION (2026-08-29): the 0/40 NLL inversion is NOT ladder-wide' establishes from the committed receipts that the unanimous 0/40 inversion occurs ONLY in the three OFF-MANIFOLD task-loss rungs (M4c/M4d/M4g, all 0W/40L, aligned NLL 2.3-2.5x baseline). Every ON-MANIFOLD rung is inert, not harmful: M3 per-token 20W/20L vs zerovec at 2.1328 vs 2.1288 baseline; M4 r64 23W/17L; r256 21W/19L at 2.1074, BELOW baseline. M4h Stage 1 runs M3's on-manifold weights and so was never in the inverting family. Its comparator is the on-manifold family, not M4g.
nll_harm_accounting.question: Does de-pooling an ON-MANIFOLD payload add BENEFIT on teacher-forced NLL? (NOT 'does it break the 0/40 inversion' — see corrected_framing.)
nll_harm_accounting.verdict: NO BENEFIT, MILD HARM — aligned loses to baseline on a majority of items. Within the on-manifold family's inert band in magnitude, but on the wrong side of it: de-pooling did not add benefit.

power.ladder_context: M4d n_disc=7 (not power-limited); M4g n_disc=3 (power-limited, min p = 0.125 > alpha).
power.reading: POWER-LIMITED: at this many discordant pairs the smallest attainable one-sided p is >= alpha, so this draw was STRUCTURALLY INCAPABLE of rejecting the accuracy null regardless of outcome. Same category as M4g (n_disc=3). The accuracy result is therefore weak evidence; read the NLL numbers instead.

primary_aligned_vs_random.gate_pass_computed_from: p_one_sided (exact sign test, ADR-028-protected, for cross-rung comparability)

what_this_rung_combines.claim: First payload in the ladder that is simultaneously ON-MANIFOLD, DE-POOLED and FUSE-DELIVERED.
what_this_rung_combines.de_pooled: payload = LAST translated token of the generated span (apply_last_row), not the mean (apply_rows_then_pool). docs/research/040: C2C transfers per-token KV cache, LatentMAS concatenates full per-token per-layer caches, Bicameral couples live per-token states, AVP's cross-model path is per-token — no surveyed successful method pools; LatentMesh is the only surveyed design that does
what_this_rung_combines.fuse_delivered: LayerEdit::Fuse, h[slot] += c*v (C2C Eq.3) — the operator M4g built
what_this_rung_combines.never_combined_before: M3/M4 were on-manifold but pooled and overwrite-delivered; M4c/M4d/M4g were fuse- or overwrite-delivered but off-manifold and pooled
what_this_rung_combines.on_manifold: M3's reconstruction-trained artifact — the manifold pre-check classifies the M3 family on-manifold and this rung's own derivation is measured in the pre-check receipt below
